groups.sourceText: doctor / go to see a doctor

items.example: I need to go to see a doctor.

groups.sourceText: nurse / fever / cough / runny nose / flu / medicine

items.example: Don't forget to do your homework.
You should take some medicine for your cold.
He was hurt badly in the accident.
He needs to treat the wound.
Be careful when crossing the road.

items.exampleZh: 她小心地处理了他的伤口。

items.example: Keep your shoes dry in winter.
items.exampleZh: 冬天让你的鞋子保持干燥。

groups.sourceText: take it easy / keep it dry

items.example: Keep the flowers in a cool place to keep them fresh.
items.exampleZh: 这要保持它们的新鲜，把花放在凉爽的地方。

groups.sourceText: How can I help you? / What can I do for you?

items.term: What can I do for you?
items.example: What can I do for you?
He looks clearly at the board.

groups.sourceText: let me check / check your homework

items.example: Let me check the map first.
I play video games a lot.
My favorite computer games are puzzles.
items.exampleZh: 我最喜欢的电脑游戏是拼图。

items.example: Can you give me some advice on this?
items.exampleZh: 你能给我这个方面的建议吗？

groups.sourceText: watch TV too much / watch less TV

items.exampleZh: 我现在少看一些电视了。
这里只剩下很少的水了。
我们现在的时间更少了一些。

items.example: She has fewer books than before.
items.exampleZh: 她现在的书比之前少一些了。

items.example: We have outdoor activities every week.
items.exampleZh: 我们每周都有户外活动。
这个周末让我们去骑自行车吧。

groups.sourceText: be good for ... / be bad for ...

items.example: Running is good for your health.
Smoking is bad for your lungs.
You should do more exercises every day.
items.exampleZh: 你应该每天多做些运动。

groups.sourceText: once a day / twice a day / three times a day

items.example: I brush my teeth once a day.
She drinks milk twice a day.
He eats breakfast three times a day.
Please take good care of your mother.
I like to talk with my friends.
He cried when he saw the dog.
He needs to reduce the noise.
The doctor advised him to reduce his pain.
We played during the summer holiday.
items.exampleZh: 我们在暑假期间玩耍了。

items.example: He had a thought about it.

items.exampleZh: 请遵守规则，不要打破它。

items.example: He broke the window last night.

items.meaningZh: 保持清醒状态（通常指入睡后）
acceptedMeaningsZh: 保持清醒状态（通常指入睡后）
items.exampleZh: 保持清醒状态（通常指入睡后）。

items.example: I am surprised by the news.
She has a good idea for the project.
items.exampleZh: 她对这个项目有一个好主意。

items.example: I will come back in a few days.
He came to my house yesterday.
I want to eat an apple now.
She ate a big meal at dinner.
He could run fast when he was young.
They couldn't understand the story then.
items.exampleZh: 他们那时听不懂这个故事。

items.example: Please wake me up at 7 a.m.
items.exampleZh: 请在早上七点叫我起床。

items.example: We spent an hour playing games.
items.exampleZh: 我们花了一小时玩游戏。

items.example: I have a pen with me.
My name is Tom, and I am called Tom.
items.exampleZh: 我叫汤姆，大家都叫我汤姆。

items.example: We are in need of food now.
I have some advice for him.
There is a math problem on the board.
items.exampleZh: 黑板上有一个数学问题。

items.example: He has had a bad cold.
Write a list of your favorite books.
items.exampleZh: 列出你最喜欢的书籍的清单。
